interpretation.measured: CSI parameter-array churn and repeated colon scans are stronger immediate targets than the separately observed per-byte String append cost.
interpretation.source_basis: Frozen d35690e native/SwiftTerminalCore.swift:443 creates a fresh numeric array per parse; :510 scans UTF8 for colons; :623 and :736 repeat colon detection in applySGR; :313 appends CSI bytes through UnicodeScalarView.
interpretation.next_candidate: Reuse bounded numeric scratch with ordinary Array value semantics, and compute/pass hasColon once. Preserve existing raw-run and filtered UInt32 validation, keyboard flags, defaults, colon-SGR ordering and malformed-input behavior.
interpretation.ownership: Packets are synchronous values consumed by handleCSI. Do not retain a permanent second scratch alias or overwrite an outer borrowed parameter view during rare recursive colon-SGR parsing. COW for genuinely live outer values remains required.
limits: Inclusive parent and child counts overlap; do not add parse to its array-growth or colon-search children, or applySGR to its searches.
The 451 figure covers whole allocation-dominated call sites, not 451 samples exclusively executing the allocator.
